name: 频谱奈奎斯特分析
description: Analyzes the frequency spectrum at Nyquist boundaries to detect upsampling artifacts. AI models often produce spectral peaks at these frequencies that are absent in real photos.
mechanism:
The 分析 process involves several stages:

1. **2D FFT Transform**: Converts the image from 空间域 to 频域 using 2D Fast 傅里叶 Transform.

2. **High-frequency 频谱 分析**: 检查 spectral energy around the Nyquist frequency (f/2). Neural network image generators (GANs, Diffusion models) use upsampling layers (bilinear, nearest-neighbor, transposed convolution) that create characteristic frequency 伪影.

3. **Periodic peak 检测**: 识别 periodic energy peaks in the frequency 频谱 — a hallmark signature of upsampling in decoder/generator architectures.

4. **Spectral comparison**: 比较 the frequency energy 分布 against natural spectral models. Camera images have natural high-frequency rolloff due to optics, while AI images show abnormal energy 分布s.
parameters:
Transform: 2D FFT (radix-2), Analysis region: Nyquist band ±10%, Metrics: high/low frequency energy ratio, periodic peak 系数, spectral 梯度

Analysis size: full image + 256x256 blocks
Normalization: logarithmic 频谱, azimuthal averaging
accuracy: 高 - 80-90% for AI images with upsampling 伪影. Particularly effective for GAN-generated images (StyleGAN, ProGAN) due to heavy use of upsampling layers.
source: Durall et al. (2020) Watch your Up-Convolution, CVPR 2020
useCase: Detection of frequency 伪影 from generative networks and upsampling. Especially effective with GAN images and AI-upscaled images.

references.title: Zhang, X. et al. (2019). Detecting and Simulating Artifacts in GAN Fake Images. IEEE WIFS.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Deep Neural Networks are Failing to Reproduce Spectral Distributions. CVPR.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS.

strengths:
• Effectively 检测 GAN-specific upsampling 伪影
• Content-independent 分析
• Difficult to forge as it relates to fundamental frequency characteristics
• Works well with uncompressed or lightly compressed images
limitations:
• Effectiveness decreases with heavy JPEG压缩
• Some newer Diffusion models produce fewer spectral 伪影
• Real images that have been resized may produce 误报
• Not effective with small images (< 256x256)
